demos.name: Intent / PAR Inspector
demos.description: Push an authorization request to a mock server (RFC 9126), watch the intent get bound into the request_uri, consent and token, and see tampering, replay and expiry refused.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 4771). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1:4771 only). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. composeFile is an absolute path on this machine; change it if the repo lives elsewhere.
